description: Launch an app on the device. Uses scrcpy START_APP when a session is active for faster launch, falls back to ADB `am start`. Supports force-stop prefix (+) to stop the app before launching.

packageName.description: Package name to launch (e.g., 'com.example.app'). Prefix with '+' to force-stop the app first (e.g., '+com.example.app')

name: app_start

source.description: Mechanism used to launch the app (scrcpy or adb)
